classes.evidence: The most recent version of mends monitoring of The BESTIntracranial pressure (ICP) in every salvageable patient with severe Traumatic brain injury (TBI). Although these guidelines acknowledge a lack of level I evidence, the recommended duration and intensity of The BESTIntracranial pressure (ICP)-lowering therapies is 20 mmHg, based mainly on observational data. An increased The BESTIntracranial pressure (ICP) is an independent risk factor for mortality and the total burden of The BESTIntracranial pressure (ICP) derangements, calculated as the area under the The BESTIntracranial pressure (ICP) curve (measured over time) above 20 mmHg, is an independent predictor of worse outcome in adults and children.
